title: [応用] Covering Indexで一覧取得を完結させる
statement: 藩士向け通知画面は SELECT user_id, created_at FROM messages WHERE tenant_id = 42 ORDER BY created_at DESC; を繰り返します。絞り込みと並び替えに加え、返却するuser_idまで含むcovering indexを設計してください。名前は自由です。

constraints.name: 列順
constraints.value: tenant_id, created_at, user_id の順に含める

starterSql: CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL);
solutionSql:
CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_messages_covering ON messages(tenant_id, created_at, user_id);
checkSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pragma_index_list('messages') il WHERE (SELECT group_concat(name, ',') FROM pragma_index_info(il.name) ORDER BY seqno) = 'tenant_id,created_at,user_id') AS ok;

benchmark.query: SELECT user_id, created_at FROM messages WHERE tenant_id = 42 ORDER BY created_at DESC;
